_README: REAL DATA, not synthetic — pulled from nflverse-data (github.com/nflverse/nflverse-data), a community project built on official NFL data feeds. `projectedPoints` and `ppgLastSeason` are derived from each player's actual 2024 regular-season per-game scoring rate (full-PPR) projected forward — this is an ESTIMATE, explicitly NOT an official 2026 fantasy projection (none exists yet from a free source as of this build — see docs/DATA_SOURCES.md). Team-defense scores are a simplified sacks/turnovers/TDs proxy only, not a full points-allowed model yet. Injury fields reflect the last reported 2024-season designation on file for that player, not a live current-week report. Regenerate with `node scripts/build-player-data.mjs` for a refresh.
